title.narrative: Reduction of the tax gap for CIT and VAT

baseline.value: The tax administration does not yet apply a risk-based approach to compliance management in line with OECD standards. This affects the compliance gap. The tax gap for CIT is 75.7%. The tax gap for VAT is 37%.

target.value: The tax gap for CIT is 69.5%. The tax gap for VAT is 31%.

actual.value: ARCA established an integrated compliance risk management (CRM) framework for taxpayer compliance
